About Organization

National Testing Agency (NTA) is an Indian government agency responsible for conducting entrance examinations for higher educational institutions.

NTA is established to conduct efficient, transparent, and international-level exams to assess the competency of candidates for admission.


About the Programme

The NTA UGC NET June 2026 exam is conducted to determine the eligibility of candidates for Assistant Professor and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Indian universities and colleges.

The exam is conducted twice a year, and the June 2026 session is now open for applications.
